## Triage

[View all](https://help.karbonhq.com/en/s/topic/0TORh0000003svHOAQ/triage)

[Can't action or assign an email](https://help.karbonhq.com/en/s/articles/4596882-can-t-action-or-assign-an-email)

To maintain privacy, you will be unable to perform certain actions on emails that are BCC'd or forwarded to your email address.

[View Article](https://help.karbonhq.com/en/s/articles/4596882-can-t-action-or-assign-an-email)

[How to have emails skip Triage](https://help.karbonhq.com/en/s/articles/1524613-having-emails-skip-triage)

In this article, you'll learn best practices for setting up certain emails to skip Triage depending on your email provider

[View Article](https://help.karbonhq.com/en/s/articles/1524613-having-emails-skip-triage)

[Why has my email split into a new conversation?](https://help.karbonhq.com/en/s/articles/1805081-why-has-my-email-split-into-a-new-conversation)

If a colleague is removed from an unshared email, the conversation is split into a new one, to protect privacy.

[View Article](https://help.karbonhq.com/en/s/articles/1805081-why-has-my-email-split-into-a-new-conversation)
